description:
## 1.12.1-legacy.4-beta.1 — experimental prerelease (2026-10-16)

### X — 4 patches

* Hide sports scores (new): selectively hides Home timeline live sports ScoreCard tiles using an APK-verified typed model filter. Real-device results pending.
* Fix external post links: preserves external status navigation.
* Hide Find more: suppresses post-detail/search recommendations.
* Hide Who to follow: suppresses recommended account modules.

For testing: enable Use pre-release patches in the existing Legacy X Patches source. Disable to return to stable 1.12.0-legacy.3.
